jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Configure and develop modules for financial flows including invoicing, accounting, and subscription management.
• Build and maintain integrations between management systems for data synchronization and automated invoice generation.
• Develop interfaces for payment service providers and bank statement imports to enable automated reconciliation.
• Design robust interfaces focusing on idempotent processing, replay mechanisms, and data integrity.
• Translate functional specifications into documented code while prioritizing standard platform capabilities.
• Participate in code reviews and support deployment pipelines across development and production environments.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in Odoo development with recent versions.
• 3+ years working with Python, the Odoo ORM, PostgreSQL, and XML views.
• Experience with Odoo accounting and invoicing modules, including journals, taxes, and multi-company setups.
• Technical experience with REST APIs, XML-RPC / JSON-RPC, webhooks, and ETL.
• Knowledge of software development lifecycle tools including Git, CI/CD, and containerized environments.
• Functional understanding of accounting principles and financial reconciliation.
• Proactive and solution-oriented approach to technical design.
• You are fluent in English with professional proficiency in French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with OWL and front-end customization.
• Previous experience in high-volume transactional or usage-based billing environments.
• Knowledge of e-mobility or energy sector financial processes.

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Zottegem.Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit? 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.Your responsibilities: 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.Working hours are from Sunday evening to Friday morning in a fixed night shift from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM.
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a fixed night shift. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You are a team player and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You perform well under pressure in a fast-paced production environment. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace during night hours. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

jobs.occupation: Dutch & French Speaking Banking Customer Support Officer – Relocation to Malta
jobs.description:
Working closely with the Wealth Support - Manager, you will be supporting our customers throughout their customer journey. You will be joining a fast-paced, innovative environment and a vibrant and dynamic team. We are driven by providing excellent customer service which in turn provides you with an excellent opportunity to grow and learn.Our shift hours are between 9 am and 8 pm in combination with a hybrid working model, this adds value to your personal planning and work life balance. The role also provides the opportunity to gain a professional certificate in Bank Mediation (Febelfin – Wet Willems).

The selected candidate should be willing to relocate to Malta.

Duties and responsibilities

• 

Attracting new customers by answering incoming calls and responding to customer emails

• 

Responding and resolving customer queries and escalating technical issues, whilst finding and explaining the best solution to solve the problem

• 

Providing customers with information about the Bank’s products and services

• 

Following up on customers’ instructions including payments, placement of trades, transfer of investment portfolios, and account opening and closure

• 

Supporting the Bank’s marketing strategy throughout various campaigns focusing on savings and wealth products

Required knowledge, skills and experience

• 

Native Dutch or French - Dutch/French-only speakers are also encouraged to apply. 

• 

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English is a plus

• 

Previous experience in a customer service role will be considered an asset

Take the lead in operations at Skechers and guide your teams toward excellence in a fully automated and fast-growing environment!

Skechers USA is a global leader in lifestyle and performance footwear, generating $9 billion in annual revenue. The company designs, develops, and markets over 3,000 styles for men, women, and children.

Why join Skechers?

• A fast-growing international company
• A warm, dynamic, and tech-forward work environment
• A culture that embraces diversity and inclusion
• A competitive salary package
• The extra perk? An on-site gym with a personal coach
To strengthen its operational team, our client Skechers is currently looking for an Operations Manager for its site in Herstal.

 

 

Jobomschrijving

As an Operations Manager at Skechers, you report directly to the Director of Operations and independently manage several departments.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Planning, organizing, and supervising daily operations to meet short- and long-term goals, while ensuring budget, deadlines, and safety standards are met in an automated environment.
• Promoting and maintaining a strong safety culture.
• Developing strategic business plans for the short, medium, and long term for your departments.
• Taking necessary actions to achieve performance objectives by defining and monitoring team KPIs, while effectively managing operational costs.
• Leading, coaching, evaluating, and developing your teams (approx. 150 people) in collaboration with Team Leaders and Leads. Communication is central to your role—both with your teams and social partners.
• Managing and optimizing automated processes with a continuous improvement mindset.
This role requires adaptability, versatility, and a proactive approach to overcoming daily challenges and driving operational excellence.

Education and technical skills:

• Minimum 3 years of proven experience in a similar role within an automated/production environment.
• Proficiency in WMS, WCS, and AS400 systems.
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook).
• Strong working knowledge of English.
Your personality and soft skills:

• Leadership – You are a driver of change and adapt easily to a constantly evolving environment.
• Communication – You adjust your communication to suit your audience and actively listen.
• Customer & results orientation – You go the extra mile to ensure customer satisfaction.
• Stress management – You remain positive and composed when facing day-to-day challenges.
• Conflict resolution & negotiation – You are assertive and diplomatic when managing tensions.
• Attention to detail – You are uncompromising when it comes to safety and adherence to procedures and workplace rules.

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Do you want to be the face of IT at an international airport site, in a demanding operational environment?

Joining SAL International at Liège Airport means ensuring, day in and day out, the continuity of IT services for a multilingual organisation at the heart of logistics and airport operations.

As part of its growth, SAL International is looking for an L1 IT Support Technician – Resident Engineer based in Liège.

WHY JOIN SAL INTERNATIONAL?

SAL International is an international player in airport handling and logistics. What you will find there:

• A dynamic, operational environment at the heart of Liège Airport
• An international and multilingual setting
• An autonomous role: you are the site's IT point of reference
• A solid structure, backed by central IT teams (L2/L3, infrastructure, network, security

Jobomschrijving

As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk.

User support

• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN)
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)
Access and security

• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)
Hardware and lifecycle

• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals)
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights)
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals
• Tickets, escalation and coordination
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…)
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.

THE TEAM & THE MANAGER

Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity
Assets

• Knowledge of Arabic
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment
• IT certifications (CompTIA A , ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)
Soft skills

• Customer focus and service mindset
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management
• Clear communication with non-technical users
• Hands-on, proactive attitude
